rankings.why: Best bedtime lock: soft dad–daughter warmth, gentle leaders, safe for all ages; civic beats stay kind if framed carefully.
Strongest respectful civic/leader gravity and comic clarity; a bit heavier for pure bedtime coziness.
Calm documentary dignity; readable and safe, slightly less webtoon immersion than comic/manhwa looks.
Peak youth emotion/webtoon immersion; drama energy risks sharper leader stylization for bedtime civic scenes.

judge.recommendation: Lock painterly_storybook for the full bedtime book—soft warmth keeps students and leaders respectful and age-safe at the same low fal cost. Use watercolor_editorial for calmer reflective civic mid-beats when you want documentary quiet without changing spend.
